Business, code and culture

I studied Business Administration in Guinea and now study Computer Engineering at Berlin College of Business and Technology.

Before I wrote software I managed artists, planned events and did external affairs for an NGO. That is why my products start with people: who buys, who sells, and how they find each other.

Today I build LAWOOL AFRICA, a family of digital marketplaces, handling product, design and full-stack development on my own.

At a glance

Based in Berlin, Germany. Work focused on West Africa.

Open to product, mobile and creative projects.
